MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is hereby informed that the Board of Directors at their meeting held today i.e. Friday, 6th November, 2026 inter-alia:
1) Approved the unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the half-year ended on 30th September, 2026, as reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee.
Unaudited Financial Results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report received from KARMA & CO. LLP, Chartered Accountants, Ahmedabad, Statutory Auditor of the Company are enclosed herewith.

Aztec Fluids & Machinery Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 06/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve This is to inform you that a meeting of Board of Directors is scheduled to be held on Friday, November 06, 2026 inter alia to transact the following businesses:

1. To consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited Financial Results along with Limited Review Reports received from the Statutory Auditors of the Company for the Half Year ended on September 30, 2026 along with the Statement of Assets and liabilities as on that date and Cash Flow Statement of the Company for the Half Year ended on September 30, 2026 pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015.
2. Any other Business with the permission of the Chair.
